summary: A funding call to support transnational research and innovation projects that accelerate the transition of cities to climate-neutral, resilient, and sustainable economies and societies. Projects must address urban challenges within three thematic Transition Pathways: 15-minute City, Circular Urban Economies, and Positive Energy Districts. The call requires consortia of at least three partners from different countries, including municipalities or local authorities.
eligible_applicants: Private organizations engaged in economic activity
Public organizations engaged in economic activity
reporting_requirements: Project must involve transnational collaboration with added value clearly stated
Engage stakeholders such as companies, public authorities, NGOs
Consider users’ needs in project goals identification
Follow Horizon Europe Framework Programme and EU co-funding requirements
